observations: The client is a static, no-build application served by Node.
Input is handled in js/controls.js via keyboard, touch and the browser Gamepad API.
The stream is decoded by the bundled jsmpeg player over a WebSocket MPEG-TS feed.
No Electron, IPC, native addon or external runtime dependency is used by the browser client.
notes: The raw REA snapshot was taken while an older js/jsmpeg.js copy was still present; the current client loads only js/jsmpeg.min.js.
Gamepad API availability was rechecked in Brave/Chromium on the plain-HTTP LAN origin: navigator.getGamepads is present even though isSecureContext is false.
limitations: AST coverage is partial; dynamic property access and runtime invocation are not proven by static analysis.
REA's analyze-web-bundle command requires a live CDP targetId; the live page was checked with Puppeteer screenshots and WebSocket/API tests instead.
